notes.title: Daycare Manager development is on hold
notes.content:
Hi everyone!

We're here with some unfortunate news. You might have noticed by the lack of activity already, but we're sorry to tell you that the development of Daycare Manager is officially on hold. 😢 Sadly, we don't know when or if we'll be available to come back to it anytime soon. 😞

Thank you so much for your interest and support! 💙💛💙

All the best!

notes.title: Daycare Management in development!
notes.content:
Hi everyone!

We're so excited to announce our new project!

[b]Daycare Manager[/b] is an innovative mix of management and simulation gameplay that will throw at you the unusual challenge of handling a nursery school. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38923419/90c133f79252c267526f82edffa3ef926eea8a79.gif[/img]

You are responsible for taking care of all your children’s needs, from arranging their playtime to feeding, nap time, schooling, and returning them safely to their parents’ arms. And yet, that is only a small percentage of your responsibilities, as you’ll have to think about expanding your business, promotion, and hiring new employees. This means building new facilities, arranging the playground, interior design, advertising, recruiting, and much more. In the end, you want your daycare to be the best out there!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38923419/2563a639f2073cb03b2e24e711ef3ca980d24990.gif[/img]

What about you? What would you like to see in Daycare Manager? 😉

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1416480/Daycare_Manager/
